query: Verify this claim and tell me whether it is true: "Python 3.13 introduced an experimental free-threaded (no-GIL) build via PEP 703."
expected_behavior: Decomposes the statement into checkable claims (Python 3.13; experimental free-threaded / no-GIL build; PEP 703) before searching
Runs web_search with a focused query and prefers an authoritative source (docs.python.org or peps.python.org)
Uses web_read on the original source rather than concluding from a search snippet
Concludes with an explicit verdict (TRUE / FALSE / OUTDATED / INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE) and cites the source URL
